title: Machine Learning & AI Fundamentals
description: Build neural networks, train supervised models, and deploy computer vision & NLP algorithms with Python.
overview: Dive deep into Machine Learning algorithms, mathematical foundations, model evaluation metrics, and PyTorch / Scikit-Learn implementations.
learningOutcomes: Understand Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement Learning concepts
Implement Linear Regression, Decision Trees, and Random Forests in Scikit-Learn
Train Deep Neural Networks with PyTorch and TensorFlow
Process text data for Sentiment Analysis using NLP Transformers
Deploy ML models as RESTful API microservices

topics.title: Linear Regression & Gradient Descent Optimization
topics.summary: Learn mathematical principles of gradient descent optimization and continuous target variable prediction.
cheatSheet: Mean Squared Error (MSE): Measures average squared difference between predictions and actual targets.
Learning Rate (α): Too large leads to divergence; too small leads to slow convergence.
Feature Scaling (StandardScaler): Crucial for gradient descent convergence speed.

topics.title: Logistic Regression & Binary Classification
topics.summary: Understand sigmoid probability mapping, binary cross-entropy loss, and classification metrics.
cheatSheet: Sigmoid outputs values strictly bounded between 0 and 1.
Decision Threshold is usually set at 0.5 for binary classification.
Use Confusion Matrix (Precision, Recall, F1-Score) to evaluate imbalanced datasets.
